en: Welcome. I am Glacia of the Elite Four. I came to Hoenn from far away, hoping to meet a trainer worth my ice.
So far, I have found only disappointment. I do hope you will be different.
Show me the heat of your spirit. My Ice-type Pokémon and I will freeze it, if we can.
Such fire... You melted my ice completely. I have not felt this in a long time.
Go on. The last of the Elite Four waits ahead, and he is not as gentle as I am.
Keep that fire burning. You will need all of it for what lies ahead.
